sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: But legal protections are only part of the challenge.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Identifying those responsible for copying the videos, and stopping them from doing it again, can also prove difficult.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: "You don't even know who's making these [videos].
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Buttermere has been described as a "fragile ecosystem under pressure" Tourism, infrastructure challenges and "outdated, undersized and poorly maintained" wastewater systems are contributing to the ecological decline of a popular lake, an environmental group has warned.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Buttermere, in the Lake District, has seen rising nutrient levels in recent years which can lead to excess phosphorus and blankets of algae.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: A new report has found farming practices alone "cannot account" for the changes.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: West Cumbria Rivers Trust (WCRT), a charity which tracked down the sources of phosphorus for the study, argues "urgent regulatory action and maintenance guidance are needed".
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: The Buttermere Nutrient Investigations Project was commissioned and funded by the Environment Agency (EA) after the lake was last year found to be failing to meet total phosphorus targets.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: WCRT said the investigation showed Buttermere - a designated Site of Special Scientific Interest and Special Area of Conservation - was a "fragile ecosystem under pressure".
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Buttermere is a naturally nutrient-poor lake, the organisation said, which provides a welcoming environment for sensitive species, such as the Arctic charr cold-water fish.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: But algae triggered by excess phosphorus can "choke out these rare habitats and degrade the lake's protected status", WCRT added.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Local wastewater infrastructure was identified as a "key area of concern", the organisation said, while agricultural investigations across major landholdings found no evidence of systemic diffuse pollution or excessive nutrient use, with soil management plans broadly appropriate.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: As they are not connected to mains drainage, many properties in the area rely on septic tanks or package treatment plants.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: However, WCRT said a number of the 11 septic tank systems identified in the catchment were "undersized, poorly maintained or past their effective lifespan, with several suspected to be discharging directly to surface water, which is not compliant with the regulations".
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Although most owners were keen to help the environment, the trust said there was a "widespread lack of awareness" about how the private systems worked and what level of maintenance was needed.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Surveys also revealed just over 40% of visitors had dogs with them and many were walked along sensitive lakeshore paths.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Nutrient fertilisation by the animals "could be significant", it was found.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: WCRT CEO Jodie Mills, said: "Our investigations show that water quality in Buttermere is suffering primarily due to private wastewater systems that are undersized, poorly maintained or overwhelmed during peak seasonal surges.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: "Many home and business owners simply didn't realise their tanks weren't performing properly.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Responsibility for the regulation of discharges belongs to the EA.
sentences.article_title: 'Urgent action' needed to protect lake

sentences.text: Peter Miles, the organisation's nature, monitoring and technical manager, said the report provided "valuable information about the sources of excess nutrients" in Buttermere.

sentences.text: Some have hailed the lack of consensus as a sign of a positive shift, despite the Turkey summit failure Some may have found it ironic that the world's biggest conference on climate change should collapse over the very mention of fossil fuels - the main cause of global warming.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Yet that is what happened in Antalya, Turkey, on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The failure tells us something about the state of climate diplomacy.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: But it may tell us even more about the increasingly divided world in which the negotiations take place.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Chris Bowen, the Australian minister who led the negotiations, spoke of a backdrop constituting "the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory".
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The competing demands, he said, had become "unbridgeable red lines".
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Murat Kurum, Turkey's environment minister and the summit's president, was blunter.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Governments should not disappoint people desperate for climate action, he suggested, by getting "hung up on one word or phrase".
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Three years ago, at COP28 in Dubai, there was agreement to transition away from fossil fuels.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The proposed Antalya Pact failed to mention them at all.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Was it really worth sacrificing the agreement over two words, then?
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The countries that rejected it said the distinction was fundamental.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: They argued that there was a world of difference between promising to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and committing to move away from the fuels responsible for most of them.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Without that explicit commitment, they feared the new agreement would weaken the one made in Dubai.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Co-leader of the negotiations Chris Bowen blamed the failure to reach an agreement on "the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory" Normally, it is difficult to establish exactly who has said what at these conferences.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Much of the bargaining takes place behind closed doors, and governments are often reluctant to admit which proposals they have opposed.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: This time, some of the opposition was public - mostly from oil-producing nations.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Mohammad Ayoub, a Saudi negotiator speaking on behalf of the 22 Arab League countries, argued that Arab nations had contributed less than 2% of historical greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: It was wealthy industrialised nations, he said, that bore the overwhelming responsibility for the problem.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: He defended the Arab countries' right to choose how to tackle climate change according to their national circumstances.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Russia's delegate Sergei Kononuchenko went further.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Cutting oil and gas supplies before demand fell, he warned, would cause shortages, higher prices and energy poverty.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: "For that reason, we cannot agree to any formulation on fossil fuel," he said.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The wider political backdrop was still more revealing.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The US, which in previous rounds of talks had helped broker compromises - sometimes working alongside China - had no official delegation in Antalya.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: President Donald Trump has rejected the entire international climate process.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: And while delegates argued over fossil fuels in Turkey, Trump, China's President Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin issued a joint declaration in Shenzhen that included a pledge to increase production and supply of refined petroleum products.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The priorities of some of the world's most powerful governments appeared very different from those being discussed in the negotiating rooms.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The EU's representative, Irish Minister Darragh O'Brien, said a deal that did not mention fossil fuels was "unconscionable" Yet, perhaps, the picture is more optimistic than it first appears.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: About 130 governments backed a demand for explicit language on moving away from fossil fuels - roughly two-thirds of the countries represented in Antalya.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Christiana Figueres, who led the UN negotiations that delivered the Paris Agreement, argued that countries were right to walk away rather than endorse a weaker political commitment that might undermine the progress already made.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Looked at this way, the collapse is not evidence that the world has lost its appetite for climate action.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Quite the opposite - a substantial majority of governments were demanding more ambitious action.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: So why not simply find a way for them to move ahead without waiting for the countries determined to block them?
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The difficulty becomes clearer when you look beyond the dispute over fossil fuels.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Kononuchenko had another target in his sights: climate finance.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Much of the money wealthy countries provide to poorer nations, he complained, comes as loans rather than grants.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: He said that developing countries ended up repaying more than they received.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: "This is an old colonial distribution of labour under a new banner," he declared.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: They argue that they are being asked to pay for damage they did little to cause while receiving too little help to adapt to climate change or build cleaner economies.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The EU had ruled out significant new funding before the negotiations began.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Mohamed Adow, the Kenyan campaigner who heads Power Shift Africa, accused Europe of rejecting a flawed deal while refusing to acknowledge its own responsibility for the failure on finance.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The UN's climate chief, Simon Stiell, said he would seek advice on potential reform to the COP process So is it possible for a majority of countries to outvote those blocking progress?
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The UN climate chief, Simon Stiell, has acknowledged the need to "improve, modernise and reform" the process.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Some governments have proposed introducing voting when consensus proves impossible.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Others want countries prepared to move faster to make their own agreements outside the formal talks.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: But there is a reason the UN climate process depends on consensus.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: International climate co-operation is largely voluntary.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Voting might produce more ambitious agreements on paper, but would it persuade the governments that had been outvoted to act?
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Consensus also offers some protection to smaller and poorer nations that might otherwise find themselves overruled by the most powerful countries.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the failure to agree a summit declaration does not mean climate action stops.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Solar panels, batteries and electric vehicles are becoming increasingly competitive, while the upheaval in global oil and gas supplies is giving countries another reason to generate their own electricity rather than depend on imported fossil fuels.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The energy transition is moving forward, whatever happens in the UN negotiating rooms.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The problem is that it is not moving nearly fast enough for the climate.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed Five takeaways from the failed climate talks COP31 Perhaps the most poignant aspect of the failed Antalya Pact is what the countries had apparently been prepared to accept.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The final draft expressed "deep concern" that global warming was expected to exceed 1.5°C in the next few years.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: It warned that further warming would cause increasingly serious damage, some of it irreversible, and called for urgent action to limit how far temperatures rose above that threshold.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: This remarkably strong language had survived into the final version, apparently without provoking the opposition that sank the agreement.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Even countries bitterly divided over fossil fuels and finance seemed prepared to acknowledge the scale of the danger.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: Yet they couldn't agree on how to respond.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: And that, perhaps, is what Antalya tells us about the state of international climate co-operation.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: The problem isn't simply finding the right words or changing the voting rules.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: It is persuading countries with very different interests to take action that no international authority can compel them to take.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: That was always going to be difficult.
sentences.article_title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

sentences.text: In today's divided world, it looks harder than ever.

sentences.text: I've just spent a week using Muse, Meta's AI agent that rolls out in the UK today.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Agents are systems that don't just respond to questions but can carry out tasks for you.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: With Muse, Meta gives the examples of "searching for a cheaper energy deal" or "sorting the school calendar." And it's true that it has helped me run my life - but it also challenged my personal privacy boundaries, and made me endure some cringeworthy interactions.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: How well Muse works really matters to Meta.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It has made a truly enormous bet on AI - of the $145bn (£111bn) it will spend this year much of it will be on building out the tech.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: For that to pay off we all need to start using it much more, and Meta hopes Muse will do for AI agents what WhatsApp did for messaging - that is, become the AI agent of choice for billions of people, putting Meta at the forefront of the AI revolution.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: But it's not just about what consumers think.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Regulators are keeping a careful eye on these emerging tools too.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "Agentic AI has significant potential to benefit people and businesses", the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) noted as Muse launched in the UK.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: But its chief executive, Paul Arnold, added it had been "clear with Meta about its responsibilities under data protection law prior to launch, particularly the requirement to ensure that users and the wider public can meaningfully understand and control how their personal data is used in the Muse product".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Muse bills itself as a personal AI agent available to anyone aged 18 and over.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "It doesn't just answer questions, it actually goes out and does work for you," said David Singleton, Meta's VP of engineering on AI products.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "So it helps people stay on top of things," he added.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It won't book the holiday without your permission - but it can then make the purchase, if you let it.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: And the permission requests keep on coming.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Every time Muse wants to do something, send something or post something, you have to allow it.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It is reassuring to know that an AI agent isn't running amok in your name, even if it also gets a bit annoying, though you can give it more autonomy (and so get fewer messages) if you adjust the settings.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Muse can't access many apps at the moment but the fundamental ones are the most personal.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I found myself wincing as I hooked it up to one of my personal email accounts, my personal calendar and my personal phone messages.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I did not allow it any access to my BBC accounts.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It can't access WhatsApp except to set up a separate chat between it and the user, and while it found me some train tickets, it could not book them via the app which I use, and which is cheaper.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It ended up telling me to book them myself.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Amazon has blocked it from its marketplace, citing data security concerns but my agent didn't seem to know that, and spent a fruitless hour repeatedly telling me it was still waiting for the page to load in order to find me some shelves.

sentences.text: A number of big UK firms are working with Meta though, including Marks & Spencer, Debenhams Group, Currys, Sainsbury's and Ocado.

sentences.text: The ICO is urging consumers to be cautious with AI agents though: "consider the pros and cons," it said in a blog post to coincide with Muse's launch. , external "Agents can make mistakes.

sentences.text: Mistakes can be magnified if the agent is acting autonomously," it noted.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Meta is keen to emphasise how its agents can be personalised: "No two Muses are alike," , external it says in its press release.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I called my agent Linda - after the robot in the BBC TV series Ann Droid - but it can take any form you like.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I gave it a British, female accent from the myriad of choices available.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: As soon as an email came in, it would summarise it for me and suggest a reply.

sentences.text: Sometimes a long time before I was actually ready to respond.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Sometimes, if I hadn't interacted with it for a while, generally because I was busy, it would pop up with some random prompt like "did you know you can change my outfit?" I expect this is designed to drive engagement: Muse is only free to use until a certain point, and then subscriptions kick in.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It also wrote some embarrassing replies to messages on my behalf: in response to a question about whether I would like to go on an outing, for example, it included all the logistics I would need in order to get there, not realising that sometimes "yes, that sounds great" is enough.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It seemed to want to have the last word quite a bit, occasionally getting stuck in a loop of "okay" and "thank you's".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Meta is relying on people choosing to trust it with even more of their personal data, despite a rather dubious track record historically with its social networks and a growing backlash against AI in general.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I asked Linda - my new dedicated if occasionally clunky assistant - if it wanted to take people's jobs.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "I'm here to take the admin and the fiddly bits off your plate," it replied, leaving me to do the "thinking".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "Everything you do is stuff I would usually think about," I responded.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: And Linda is helping fuel that revolution, one calendar invite at a time.

sentences.text: Nvidia and its co-founder Jensen Huang have been at the centre of the artificial intelligence (AI) spending boom.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: No company or chief executive has arguably been more consequential to the development of AI in recent years, with the US microchip manufacturer under Huang positioning itself as a critical cog in the development of the world-changing technology.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: That central position prompted questions, in the aftermath of Huang's departure over revelations of extramarital affairs, over how important he was to the wider AI industry and US economy.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: The fact he has been handed his job back after just 11 days in a U-turn by Nvidia's board implies the top brass believe Huang is irreplaceable.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Shares in the company have surged on the news of Huang's shock return, following a period of sharp declines.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: While Nvidia is not as much of a household name as other Big Tech players such as Apple, Amazon and Microsoft, the company has been just as integral to the booming US stock market of recent years.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: The billions of dollars being funnelled into AI and the construction of data centres has bolstered the American economy, with Nvidia being one of the biggest spenders.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Originally focusing on chips which process graphics for computer games, it pivoted to making the chips used in AI systems and now dominates the market.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: It is now one the most valuable firms in the world and its rapid growth is poised to continue as the firm's quarterly sales doubled from a year earlier.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Huang played a major role in the company, leading its shift towards AI, and maintained a firm grip on it, with up to 200 people directly reporting to him.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Some suggested his departure, which was sparked by the emergence that Huang had an affair with a woman alleged to have been a spy for China, posed a risk to the wider AI industry.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: That was because it was unclear whether Nvidia would change strategy and potentially rein in spending - a move could have had wider implications for the US economy, but which looks unlikely now Huang has returned.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: The fears were sparked due to Nvidia being a key source of finance for many firms, as well as being a microchip supplier.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: On its journey to the top of the AI industry, it has, through Huang, created a spider's web of deals through what is known as "circular financing".
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Not only does it sell microchips to its customers, which include the likes of Meta, SpaceX and OpenAI, it has also provided funds for them and other firms in the supply chain by either handing out loans or investing in them directly.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: The practice has prompted concerns among some investors, who worry what might happen if Nvidia were to turn off the spending taps.
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: If investment dried up, would other firms in the supply chain cut spending or jobs themselves?
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: Would that spread to the wider US economy?
sentences.article_title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?

sentences.text: "Is Jensen Huang the most valuable man on the planet?

sentences.text: However, Huang's return to Nvidia does not solve the wider issues rattling the tech stock markets in recent weeks.

sentences.text: During the trial, the prosecution described Kurtaj as a "leading light" in the teen gang Lapsus$ A cyber criminal who hacked the maker of Grand Theft Auto has been released on licence on the same day as being sentenced to 7 years in prison.

sentences.text: Multiple offender Arion Kurtaj, from Oxford, was released from custody with the judge warning him: "Don't let this happen again." The now 21-year-old hacked several companies and individuals, including GTA 6-maker Rockstar Games, whom he tried to extort after stealing clips of the unfinished game in 2022.

sentences.text: Kurtaj had pleaded guilty last Monday at Woolwich Crown Court to the Rockstar hack and a handful of others which he carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old with the hacking gang Lapsus$.

sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: But, in an unusual move, he was subsequently deemed fit to stand trial and released to a normal prison in January.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He was there for protection from rival hackers who had threatened to attack him for his stolen stashes of Bitcoin.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.article_title: Five Mexicans arrested in Nigeria over $227m meth lab

sentences.text: President Cyril Ramaphosa has faced calls to resign over his handling of the "Farmgate" scandal South African President Cyril Ramaphosa has won a legal battle to overturn a report that found he may have a case to answer over the theft of large sums of cash from his private farm.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: In 2022, an independent panel said Ramaphosa may have committed serious misconduct relating to the theft of $580,000 (£443,000), hidden in a sofa, at his Phala Phala game farm in the Limpopo province.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: He denied any wrongdoing.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Ramaphosa challenged the findings of the report in court after the Constitutional Court ruled that parliament had violated the constitution by blocking moves to impeach him.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The Western Cape high court ruled that the panel's report was unlawful and set it aside "in its entirety".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: In its judgment, the court said the panel, appointed by parliament to investigate the allegations against Ramaphosa, had "misconstrued its function, the nature of the inquiry it was to conduct and the recommendation it was required to make".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: "It went beyond its lawful remit ... and made several material errors of law. [Therefore] the report of the independent panel ... is declared unlawful and is reviewed and set aside in its entirety," Judge Nolwazi Mabindla-Boqwana said.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The court also declared unlawful the steps taken by parliament in relation to the report.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Political analyst Khanyi Magubane said the court ruling was a victory for Ramaphosa as it gave him "political and constitutional credibility".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: She made it clear that the ruling was not a criminal finding on possible improper conduct at the farm but rather an indictment at the independent panel's report.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: "[So] he does get significant reprieve ... but there will always be the shadow of the Phala Phala report," Magubane said.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The ruling effectively removes the basis for the parliamentary impeachment process against Ramaphosa, although opposition parties have indicated they intend to challenge the decision.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The scandal, dubbed "Farmgate" by local media, has has dogged Ramaphosa since it emerged in 2022, when former spy chief Arthur Fraser reported the matter to police in a dossier.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Fraser, an ally of former President Jacob Zuma, accused Ramaphosa of concealing the theft from the police and tax authorities.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The break-in took place in 2020, when thieves allegedly stole bundles of US dollar bills hidden inside a sofa at the farm.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Opposition parties, pictured above, have been vocal in their call for the president to account for his role in the saga Earlier this month, two people were found guilty of the theft.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Ramaphosa confirmed that a robbery had taken place but said the money had been from the legitimate sale of buffalo from his livestock business.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Several investigations cleared him of any wrongdoing, but parliament began an impeachment proceedings in 2022 and appointed an independent panel to investigate the allegations.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The panel made a series of damaging findings, including that there was "substantial doubt about the legitimacy of the source of the currency that was stolen".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: It also concluded that Ramaphosa "has a case to answer".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Ramaphosa initially challenged the report in court but withdrew his application after parliament voted against adopting its findings.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: He revived the legal challenge again in May this year after the Constitutional Court, the country's highest court , ruled that parliament had acted unconstitutionally by blocking moves to impeach him.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: It ordered parliament to refer the report to an impeachment committee.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: In his latest challenge, Ramaphosa argued that the panel had "misconceived its mandate, misjudged the information placed before it and misinterpreted the four charges advanced against me".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: The Western Cape High Court's ruling could bring the current impeachment process to an end, unless parliament successfully challenges the decision.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: If they do, and the appeal is successful, the parliamentary committee would be able to examine the charges against the president and make a recommendation.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: If the committee recommends impeachment, parliament would have to vote on whether to remove him from office.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: This would require the support of at least two-thirds majority in parliament.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Ramaphosa's Africa National Congress (ANC) has enough parliamentary seats to block such a move.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: He is the first president to face impeachment proceedings under the rules introduced in 2018.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Legal expert Professor Richard Calland told the BBC he had expected the court ruling, given what he termed as "fault lines" in the independent panel's report.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Calland said the court's findings now meant that the impeachment process was "dead in the water [and] cannot continue".
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: He said that any political party that wanted to revive it "would have to come up with a whole new basis" for this.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: Calland said political parties who want to hold Ramaphosa accountable would likely seek to appeal the ruling but it was unlikely parliament would also do so.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.text: "So, the president's political career is now free of the cloud of impeachment," he said.
sentences.article_title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat

sentences.article_title: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times

sentences.text: Francis, who led the Catholic Church for 12 years until his death in 2025, later apologised and summoned the country's bishops to Rome, where they all offered to resign .

sentences.text: Pugh said the Strait of Hormuz has an "extraordinary natural world" beneath the surface A British endurance swimmer has completed a three-day swim through the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to what he says is the environmental cost of the conflict involving Iran.
